senses.en: covered with or resembling shrubs

example.en: The hillside was thick with shrubby growth.
example.zh: 山坡上长满了灌木。

senses.en: a vehicle that travels over water or land on a cushion of air

example.en: The hovercraft crossed the channel in thirty minutes.
example.zh: 气垫船三十分钟就穿越了海峡。

senses.en: knowledge or awareness of something

example.en: The committee took cognizance of the new safety concerns.
example.zh: 委员会注意到了新的安全问题。

senses.en: members of the animal kingdom, such as birds, fish, insects, and mammals; plural of animal

example.en: The park is home to many wild animals.
example.zh: 这座公园是许多野生动物的栖息地。

senses.en: any object, event, or fact; something of any kind

example.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
example.zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

senses.en: at all; in any degree
senses.zh: 根本；丝毫（用于否定或疑问）

example.en: It isn't anything like as cold as it was yesterday.
example.zh: 今天远没有昨天那么冷。

senses.en: very pleasing or enjoyable

example.en: We had a delightful evening at the concert.
example.zh: 我们在音乐会上度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

senses.en: an official who watches a game and enforces the rules

example.en: The umpire called the ball foul.
example.zh: 裁判判定该球出界。

senses.en: to act as the umpire in a game

example.en: She umpired the tennis match on Saturday.
example.zh: 她周六执裁了那场网球比赛。

senses.en: to enjoy oneself in a lively, noisy way, or to take great delight in something

example.en: The fans reveled in their team's victory.
example.zh: 球迷们为球队的胜利欣喜若狂。

senses.en: lively and noisy celebration

example.en: The festival ended with a night of revels.
example.zh: 节日在通宵狂欢中落幕。

senses.en: firm and loyal in support of someone or something

example.en: He remained a staunch supporter of the team through good times and bad.
example.zh: 无论顺境逆境，他始终是这支球队的坚定支持者。

senses.en: to stop the flow of a liquid, especially blood

example.en: Nurses worked quickly to staunch the bleeding.
example.zh: 护士们迅速止住了流血。

senses.en: in a short time from now; soon

example.en: The train will arrive shortly.
example.zh: 火车很快就要到了。

senses.en: in a brief or abrupt manner

example.en: She replied shortly, clearly annoyed.
example.zh: 她简短生硬地回答，显然生气了。

senses.en: A small place where things are made or repaired by hand or with machines.
senses.zh: 手工或使用机器制作、修理物品的小场所。

example.en: She spent the afternoon in the workshop repairing a wooden chair.
example.zh: 她下午在工场里修理一把木椅。

senses.en: A short intensive class or meeting for a small group, often focused on discussion and problem solving.
senses.zh: 面向小组的短期强化课程或会议，常侧重讨论和解决问题。

example.en: The teachers attended a two-day workshop on classroom management.
example.zh: 教师们参加了为期两天的课堂管理研讨会。

senses.en: a substance made from two or more chemical elements joined together

example.en: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
example.zh: 水是氢和氧的化合物。

senses.en: made of two or more parts or words
senses.zh: 复合的；由两部分或多部分组成的

example.en: The word "firefighter" is a compound noun made of two words.
example.zh: 单词 firefighter 是由两个词组成的复合名词。

senses.en: to make a problem or bad situation worse

example.en: The delay compounded the problem.
example.zh: 延误使问题更加严重。

senses.en: a soft silver-white chemical element that is common in salt; symbol Na
senses.zh: 钠（一种化学元素，符号 Na）

example.en: Sodium reacts violently when it touches water.
example.zh: 钠接触水时会发生剧烈反应。

senses.en: to finish doing or making something

example.en: The team completed the survey in one day.
example.zh: 团队在一天内完成了这项调查。

senses.en: having every necessary part; not missing anything

example.en: The set is complete; nothing is missing.
example.zh: 这套东西是完整的，什么都不缺。

senses.en: to make something whole by adding what is missing

example.en: The final chapter completes the story.
example.zh: 最后一章使故事完整。

senses.en: happening once every year

example.en: The school holds an annual science fair in May.
example.zh: 学校每年五月举办一次科学展。

senses.en: calculated or measured over a period of one year

example.en: The region receives about 800 millimeters of annual rainfall.
example.zh: 该地区年降雨量约为800毫米。

senses.en: a plant that completes its life cycle within one year

example.en: Marigolds are annuals, so they complete their life cycle in one growing season.
example.zh: 万寿菊是一年生植物，因此在一个生长季内完成生命周期。

senses.en: extremely good, pleasant, or enjoyable

example.en: We had a wonderful time at the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩上玩得非常愉快。

senses.en: the act or activity of putting words on paper or a screen

example.en: She spends an hour writing every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上花一小时写作。

senses.en: written works, especially a body of texts by an author

example.en: His writings on history are widely read.
example.zh: 他的历史著作被广泛阅读。

senses.en: the way someone forms letters when writing by hand

example.en: His writing is hard to read.
example.zh: 他的字迹很难辨认。

senses.en: to plan or want to do something

example.en: We intend to leave early tomorrow.
example.zh: 我们打算明天早点离开。

senses.en: to mean something in a particular way

example.en: The remark was intended as a warning.
example.zh: 这句话意在警告。

senses.en: to design something for a particular person or use

example.en: This room is intended for guests.
example.zh: 这个房间是供客人使用的。

senses.en: to be or move around something on all sides, especially in order to enclose it

example.en: The police surrounded the building.
example.zh: 警察包围了那栋建筑。

senses.en: to be all around something in a way that affects it or is closely connected with it

example.en: Mystery surrounds the case.
example.zh: 这起案件笼罩着谜团。

senses.en: increasing or changing in relation to something else; corresponding in size or amount

example.en: The punishment should be proportional to the seriousness of the offense.
example.zh: 惩罚应与过错的严重程度成比例。

senses.en: having a constant ratio, especially in mathematics

example.en: In a proportional relationship, doubling one quantity doubles the other.
example.zh: 在比例关系中，一个量翻倍，另一个量也翻倍。

senses.en: something that is annoying or causes trouble

example.en: Moving to a new apartment was a big hassle.
example.zh: 搬进新公寓是件很麻烦的事。

senses.en: to repeatedly annoy or bother someone

example.en: Stop hassling me about cleaning my room.
example.zh: 别再为打扫房间的事烦我了。

senses.en: to bring under control, especially by force

example.en: The police quickly subdued the suspect.
example.zh: 警方迅速制服了嫌疑人。

senses.en: to suppress or hold back a feeling or impulse

example.en: She struggled to subdue her anger.
example.zh: 她努力克制自己的怒气。

senses.en: to make something less intense or strong

example.en: The lighting subdued the bright colors of the room.
example.zh: 灯光减弱了房间里明亮的色彩。

senses.en: an abnormal mass of tissue growing in the body

example.en: The doctors found a small tumor in his lung.
example.zh: 医生在他的肺部发现了一个小肿瘤。

senses.en: a set of medical symptoms that occur together and indicate a particular condition

example.en: Down syndrome is a genetic condition that affects development.
example.zh: 唐氏综合征是一种影响发育的遗传性疾病。

senses.en: a characteristic set of opinions or behaviours typical of a group
senses.zh: （某类人典型的）典型表现；行为特征

example.en: The 'empty nest' syndrome often affects parents whose children have left home.
example.zh: “空巢”综合征常发生在子女离家后的父母身上。

senses.en: a large grand building where a king, queen, or other ruler lives

example.en: The tourists visited the royal palace in the morning.
example.zh: 游客们上午参观了王宫。

senses.en: a very large and impressive building, such as a museum or hotel
senses.zh: 华丽的大厦；宏大的公共建筑

example.en: The old theater is a real palace of entertainment.
example.zh: 这座老剧院是真正的娱乐殿堂。

senses.en: a position on a list of people or things ordered by rank

example.en: The team moved up in the world rankings.
example.zh: 该队在世界排名中上升了。

senses.en: having a high position in a group or organization

example.en: A ranking official will attend the ceremony.
example.zh: 一位高级官员将出席仪式。

senses.en: a highly addictive illegal drug made from morphine

example.en: Heroin is a dangerous and highly addictive drug.
example.zh: 海洛因是一种危险且极易成瘾的毒品。

senses.en: relating to planets

example.en: Earth is a planetary body orbiting the Sun.
example.zh: 地球是围绕太阳运行的一颗行星。

senses.en: relating to the whole Earth; global

example.en: Climate change is a planetary problem.
example.zh: 气候变化是一个全球性问题。

senses.en: relating to geometry

example.en: The students solved a geometrical problem about the area of a triangle.
example.zh: 学生们解了一道关于三角形面积的几何题。

senses.en: having simple regular shapes or patterns, like squares or circles
senses.zh: 几何图形的；图案规整的

example.en: The wallpaper has a geometrical pattern of triangles and circles.
example.zh: 这壁纸有三角形和圆形组成的几何图案。

senses.en: a diagram showing the relationship between quantities, usually with lines or curves on axes

example.en: The graph shows how sales increased last year.
example.zh: 这张图表显示了去年销售额的增长情况。

senses.en: a network of points connected by lines, used in mathematics and computing
senses.zh: 图；图结构（数学、计算机用语）

example.en: This graph represents the connections between computers in the network.
example.zh: 这个图表示网络中计算机之间的连接关系。

senses.en: to represent or plot data using a graph

example.en: Graph the results to compare the two groups.
example.zh: 把结果绘成图来比较两组数据。

senses.en: a place where people pay to sit down and eat meals

example.en: We had dinner at a nice Italian restaurant downtown.
example.zh: 我们在市中心一家不错的意大利餐馆吃了晚饭。

senses.en: the largest continent, joined to Europe on the west

example.en: Many countries in Asia have rapidly growing economies.
example.zh: 亚洲许多国家的经济快速增长。

senses.en: a description of a possible situation or sequence of events

example.en: The company considered the worst-case scenario before launching the product.
example.zh: 公司在推出产品之前考虑了最坏的情况。

senses.en: an outline of the plot of a play or film
senses.zh: （戏剧、电影的）情节梗概；脚本提纲

example.en: The director asked the writer to expand the scenario into a full script.
example.zh: 导演让编剧把情节梗概扩写成完整的剧本。

senses.en: a gambling game in which a ball spins around a wheel and players bet on where it will stop

example.en: He lost all his money playing roulette.
example.zh: 他玩轮盘赌输光了所有的钱。

senses.en: not reasonable or based on sound logic

example.en: It is illogical to spend money you don't have.
example.zh: 花自己没有的钱是不合逻辑的。

senses.en: the act of starting something again after a pause

example.en: Both sides agreed to the resumption of peace talks.
example.zh: 双方同意恢复和谈。

senses.en: very severe or harmful in its effects, especially of a disease, pathogen, or poison
senses.zh: 毒力强的；危害严重的；剧毒的

example.en: A highly virulent strain of the virus spread through the region.
example.zh: 一种毒性极强的病毒毒株在该地区传播。

senses.en: (of speech or feelings) bitter and hostile

example.en: He launched a virulent attack on his critics.
example.zh: 他对批评者发起了恶毒的攻击。

senses.en: brightness or light given off by something

example.en: The radiance of the sunrise filled the sky.
example.zh: 朝阳的光辉洒满了天空。

senses.en: a glowing appearance, especially on a person's face

example.en: She was glowing with radiance on her wedding day.
example.zh: 婚礼那天她容光焕发。

senses.en: used to say that something is possible

example.en: She may arrive later.
example.zh: 她可能晚点到。

senses.en: used to ask for or give permission

example.en: May I open the window?
example.zh: 我可以打开窗户吗？

senses.en: used to express a wish or hope

example.en: May you have a happy birthday!
example.zh: 祝你生日快乐！

senses.en: (capitalized: May) the fifth month of the year
senses.zh: 五月（月份名，首字母大写）

example.en: The course begins in May.
example.zh: 课程于五月开始。

senses.en: the way someone feels at a particular time

example.en: Her cheerful mood lifted everyone's spirits.
example.zh: 她愉快的心情让大家振作起来。

senses.en: the general feeling or atmosphere of a place or situation

example.en: The quiet music created a relaxed mood.
example.zh: 安静的音乐营造出轻松的氛围。

senses.en: a verb form that shows whether a statement is a fact, command, wish, etc.

example.en: In English, the imperative mood is used for commands.
example.zh: 在英语中，祈使语气用于表示命令。

senses.en: facts or signs that show something is true

example.en: There is strong evidence that exercise improves sleep.
example.zh: 有强有力的证据表明锻炼能改善睡眠。

senses.en: information or objects used in a court to prove something

example.en: The police collected evidence at the scene.
example.zh: 警方在现场收集了证据。

senses.en: to show or prove something clearly

example.en: The results evidence a clear improvement in performance.
example.zh: 结果证明了表现的明显改善。

senses.en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow better

example.en: The farmer spread fertilizer on the field before planting.
example.zh: 农民在播种前把肥料撒到田里。

senses.en: unable to help yourself or act without help

example.en: She felt helpless when her phone died and she couldn't call anyone.
example.zh: 手机没电又无法联系任何人时，她感到很无助。

senses.en: lacking strength or power

example.en: The helpless baby bird could not leave the nest yet.
example.zh: 那只无助的雏鸟还无法离开鸟巢。

senses.en: a machine part that reduces friction between moving parts

example.en: The worn bearing caused the wheel to wobble.
example.zh: 磨损的轴承导致车轮晃动。

senses.en: a person's way of standing, moving, or behaving

example.en: She has a confident bearing.
example.zh: 她举止自信。

senses.en: direction or position relative to a known point

example.en: The sailors took a bearing on the lighthouse.
example.zh: 水手们以灯塔为参照测定方位。

senses.en: relevance or connection to something

example.en: His comments have no bearing on the case.
example.zh: 他的评论与本案无关。

senses.en: to come out of an egg; to make an egg hatch

example.en: The chicks will hatch after about three weeks.
example.zh: 小鸡大约三周后会孵出来。

senses.en: to secretly plan or devise something

example.en: They hatched a plan to surprise her on her birthday.
example.zh: 他们策划了一个在她生日时给她惊喜的计划。

senses.en: an opening or door in a floor, ceiling, or ship's deck

example.en: The crew opened the hatch to unload the cargo.
example.zh: 船员打开舱口卸货。

senses.en: an assessment of the value, quality, or performance of something or someone

example.en: Her manager gave her a positive appraisal during the annual review.
example.zh: 年度考核中，她的经理给了她积极的评价。

senses.en: an official estimate of the monetary value of something

example.en: The bank required an appraisal of the house before approving the loan.
example.zh: 银行在批准贷款前要求对该房屋进行估价。

senses.en: great energy and enthusiasm

example.en: She attacked the project with great zest.
example.zh: 她满怀热情地投入这个项目。

senses.en: the grated peel of a citrus fruit used to add flavor

example.en: Add some lemon zest to the batter.
example.zh: 在面糊里加些柠檬皮屑。

senses.en: to grate the peel of a citrus fruit into food

example.en: Zest the lemon over the salad.
example.zh: 把柠檬皮屑刮到沙拉上。

senses.en: no longer useful or fashionable; old

example.en: The company still uses outdated equipment.
example.zh: 这家公司仍在使用过时的设备。

senses.en: a large whale with long flippers, known for its songs and leaping out of the water

example.en: We watched humpbacks breach near the boat.
example.zh: 我们看着座头鲸在小船附近跃出水面。

senses.en: medical: an abnormally rounded upper back; a person with such a back

example.en: Seated work can worsen a slight humpback over time.
example.zh: 久坐工作会随时间加重轻微的驼背。

senses.en: elaborately or excessively ornamented, especially in style
senses.zh: （文风、装饰）华丽的；过分雕饰的

example.en: His florid prose was hard to follow.
example.zh: 他那华丽的文风让人难以理解。

senses.en: having a reddish, healthy complexion

example.en: The old farmer had a florid face from working outdoors.
example.zh: 老农夫常年在户外劳作，面色红润。

senses.en: a cage or shed for chickens or other poultry

example.en: The chickens were shut in the coop for the night.
example.zh: 鸡晚上被关进了鸡舍。

senses.en: to keep a person or animal in a small confined space (often coop up)
senses.zh: 把……关在狭小空间里（常与 up 连用）

example.en: The children felt restless after being cooped up indoors all day.
example.zh: 孩子们在室内关了一整天后感到烦躁不安。

senses.en: not allowing liquids or gases to pass through

example.en: The pond was lined with an impermeable membrane.
example.zh: 池塘铺了一层不透水的薄膜。

senses.en: a loud noise made by many people shouting

example.en: The clamor of the crowd could be heard from far away.
example.zh: 人群的喧闹声很远就能听到。

senses.en: to demand something loudly and repeatedly

example.en: The fans clamored for tickets to the concert.
example.zh: 歌迷们大声要求购买演唱会门票。

senses.en: showing love and warmth toward someone

example.en: She gave her grandmother an affectionate hug.
example.zh: 她深情地拥抱了祖母。

senses.en: the fact of placing things side by side, often for contrast or effect

example.en: The juxtaposition of the old and new buildings is striking.
example.zh: 新旧建筑的并置非常醒目。

senses.en: a total amount made by combining several things

example.en: The aggregate of their sales exceeded one million dollars.
example.zh: 他们的销售总额超过了一百万美元。

senses.en: to combine or collect things into a single total

example.en: The app aggregates data from many websites.
example.zh: 这款应用汇总来自许多网站的数据。

senses.en: sand or gravel mixed with cement to make concrete

example.en: Concrete is made from cement, water, and aggregate.
example.zh: 混凝土由水泥、水和骨料制成。

senses.en: made up of separate parts combined into a whole; total

example.en: The aggregate score of the two matches was 5–3.
example.zh: 两场比赛的总比分为5比3。

senses.en: the cold continent around the South Pole

example.en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth.
example.zh: 南极洲是地球上最冷的地方。

senses.en: a feeling of nervousness or discomfort around other people

example.en: Her shyness made it hard to speak in front of the class.
example.zh: 她的羞怯让她很难在全班面前发言。

senses.en: sun-dried brick made of clay, used for building in hot dry regions

example.en: Many houses in the desert are built of adobe.
example.zh: 沙漠地区的许多房屋是用土坯建造的。

senses.en: the clay used to make such bricks

example.en: They shaped the adobe into bricks by hand.
example.zh: 他们用手把黏土制成砖坯。

senses.en: a scientist who studies fossils of animals and plants from long ago

example.en: The paleontologist discovered dinosaur bones in the desert.
example.zh: 这位古生物学家在沙漠中发现了恐龙骨头。

senses.en: a smaller amount or number than is needed

example.en: The report was weakened by a paucity of reliable data.
example.zh: 缺乏可靠数据削弱了这份报告。

senses.en: a word with the same or nearly the same meaning as another word

example.en: 'Happy' is a synonym of 'glad'.
example.zh: “happy”是“glad”的同义词。

senses.en: the immature form of an insect or other animal that changes greatly before adulthood

example.en: Mosquito larvae develop in standing water.
example.zh: 蚊子幼虫在死水中发育。

senses.en: having or appearing to have length, width, and depth

example.en: The movie is shown in three-dimensional format.
example.zh: 这部电影以三维格式放映。
